acceptanceProfiles.CAT-STANDARD: Verify exact identity/name or reviewed alias, exercise-specific variant/attachment and facility compatibility, bodyweight/assistance/implement and exact physical increments, direct/indirect muscle credits, realistic rep ranges, selection/swap/authoring, actual logging and history/progression; explicit-only variants never auto-selected unless independently approved.
acceptanceProfiles.CAT-MEASURED: Verify typed hold seconds/carry centimeters/banded reps, side and physical-load requirements, stopwatch/distance entry, generated and custom eligibility, actual observation and history, recovery/corrections and appropriate measured progression; never route through fictitious weighted reps.
